result.remark_en:
A. The faculty and staff will officially start working on August 31st. All undergraduate students in the school will register on August 31st and September 1st, and officially start classes on September 2nd. Undergraduate students will attend classes for 16 weeks this semester, and the course will end on December 20th (the day of classes). The mid-term exams will be held on October 26th, October 27th, November 2nd, and November 3rd. The final review and college entrance examination period for regular undergraduate students is from December 26, 2024 to December 31, 2024. The final exam period is from January 2nd to January 10th, 2025.

B. Undergraduate freshmen will report on September 7th and 8th, undergo military training from September 9th to 24th, enroll and receive professional education from September 25th to 27th, officially start classes on September 29th, and the courses will end on December 25th, 2024 (with classes scheduled on the same day and last Wednesday). Freshmen will have classes on December 24th and last Thursday. New students attend classes for a total of 12 weeks.

C. Graduate students and seniors will register on September 6th, officially start classes on September 9th, and the course will end on December 27th (with classes scheduled on the same day); The new graduate students of 2024 will report on September 7th and 8th, start their education on September 9th (courses that conflict with admission education will be arranged by teachers themselves), officially start classes on September 10th, and end their classes on December 27th (classes will be held on the same day). Graduate students of each grade attend classes for a total of 16 weeks. The period from December 30, 2024 to January 8, 2025 is for review and course assessment.

D. Mid-Autumn Festival holiday from September 15 to September 17; National Day holiday from October 1st to October 7th; Make up for Monday's class on September 14th and Friday's class on September 29th; Make up for Tuesday's class on October 12th; The school sports meet will be held from October 17th to 19th; On January 1, 2025, there will be a holiday (if the state makes other regulations on holidays, the specific arrangements for school holidays shall prevail). Due to statutory holidays, teachers are responsible for arranging make-up classes to ensure the completion of teaching tasks.

E.The winter vacation starts on January 11, 2025.
